name: A. Clybourn's market on the market square
trade: butcher — slaughtering, and a retail market stall

proprietors.name: A. Clybourn
proprietors.basis: The register matches the printed name to the town card clybourne_archibald (action: enrich), so this is the same person the resident layer already holds. Dated by the printing window, which bounds the reading and does not date the partnership.

staff.name: Ezra Hastings
staff.basis: The staffing model puts 1 of this role in a butcher's shop at the typical band and 1 at the high end, on directory_1839. 16 butchers in 1839 against the one shop and the market here. This person is a reconstructed resident of the trade with no workplace of their own; the house is one the business layer already holds, and this row points at it rather than raising anything. Seated by tools/seat_reconstructed_trades_1835.py (T-1433) off 1835_business_staffing_model#butcher_shop.butcher; carried onto this record by tools/staff_the_houses_1835.py (T-1462).
staff.replaceable_by: a source naming where this person worked, which retires the draw

staffing.basis: the 1835 business staffing model's band for this class, with the reconstructed seats T-1433 put in this house marked drawn
staffing.replaceable_by: a source naming the hands of this house, which retires every reconstructed seat it covers

shortfall.statement: The staffing model puts 1 hand(s) about this kind of house at its typical band and this house carries 1. It is at its band.
shortfall.counted_here: the reconstructed hands this overlay seats. A hand a SOURCE names carries its own citation in staff[] and is counted by the attested join, not by this.
shortfall.replaceable_by: a source naming a hand at this house, which retires the seat it replaces, or the mint T-1448 ordered, which draws the rest

locations.basis: The register resolved no place for this house at the scene date.
locations.limit_reason: No street the model holds. The anchor 'the market square in Chicago' names nothing the committed town holds.

dates.basis: No opening is announced. The first printing, 1833-12-10, is the bound: the house was trading by then and the record does not say when it began.

proprietor_community.basis: The 1 keeper(s) this record names and the resident layer holds a card for all read southern: A. Clybourn (southern). A house is not its keeper, so the reading is an inference about the house and is capped there.

replaceable_by: A directory, a deed or a later reading that names this house's premises, its staff or its dates more exactly than the newspapers do.
